latest.title: AI Companies to Directly Purchase Memory, Anthropic's DRAM Demand Rivals NVIDIA's
latest.summary: Until now, AI model developers like Anthropic have secured computing resources based on NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs, Amazon Web Services, AWS Trainium, and others. In this process, high-bandwidth memory ...
highlights: Until now, AI model developers like Anthropic have secured computing resources based on NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs, Amazon Web Services, AWS Trainium, and others. In this process, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and server DRAM have primarily been procured by chip and cloud/server companies. If direct memory purchases expand, model developers could negotiate supply volumes directly with manufacturers and utilize the secured memory within existing chip and server supply chains. [...] Projections have emerged that Anthropic and OpenAI will begin directly purchasing products from memory manufacturers starting in 2027. Currently, chip, cloud, and server companies primarily procure the memory used by AI model companies for their servers. Going forward, AI model companies could become major clients directly negotiating supply volumes with memory manufacturers. [...] Collaboration between AI model companies and memory manufacturers is already underway. In May 2026, Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron participated as “strategic infrastructure partners” in Anthropic’s Series H funding round. Micron later announced a memory and storage supply agreement with Anthropic. OpenAI also agreed in October 2025 to expand the supply of advanced memory required for the Stargate Project with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

“这个案子的实质是，换个壳子往外卖，这条路已经走不通了。”一位专注AI Agent商业化的企业战略顾问对《凤凰WEEKLY财经》表示，Manus团队、数据、研发本来都在国内，后来把总部迁到新加坡，并剥离中国子公司，同时将数据传到境外，再卖给Meta，触碰了核心技术外流与数据出境两条红线。

“对其他有外资背景的AI公司来说，想靠‘换个马甲出海’卖给外资，这个模式已经不可行了。”他表示。
